kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenues generated by the company.
kpis.description: Revenue reached $2.919 billion for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026.
kpis.signal: Revenue growth of 12% for fiscal year 2026.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit realized after deduction of all expenses.
kpis.description: The company recorded net income of $235 million for fiscal year 2026, compared to a net loss of $355 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Transition from net loss to significant net income indicating a return to profitability.

kpis.name: Customers with ACV > $100k
kpis.explanation: Number of customers generating more than $100,000 in annual contract value.
kpis.description: The number of customers with annual contract value exceeding $100,000 reached 5,100 as of January 31, 2026.
kpis.signal: Continued increase in large accounts, indicating value perceived by enterprises.

kpis.name: Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate
kpis.explanation: Measures the ability to increase revenue from existing customers.
kpis.description: Dollar-Based Net Retention Rate was 106% for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, indicating revenue expansion among existing customers.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in net retention rate, but remains above 100% indicating growth within the existing customer base.

kpis.name: Current Remaining Performance Obligations
kpis.explanation: Contractual revenues not yet recognized, to be collected within the next 12 months.
kpis.description: Current remaining performance obligations totaled $2.513 billion as of January 31, 2026.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in current remaining performance obligations, foreshadowing future revenue.

kpis.name: Total Remaining Performance Obligations
kpis.explanation: Contractual revenues not yet recognized, including future payments beyond 12 months.
kpis.description: Total remaining performance obligations totaled $4.827 billion as of January 31, 2026.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in total backlog, ensuring visibility into longer-term revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: Okta positions itself as a potential leader in identity management for AI agents and non-human identities (NHI), anticipating a new wave of AI-related demand.
evidence: Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform enable our customers to securely connect the right people to the right technologies and services at the right time.
the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and the deployment of AI agents may, over time, create new opportunities for identity management.

We see a potential long-term opportunity for our platforms to serve as a unified, independent control plane for non-human identities (NHIs) and AI agents, a distinct class of identity that requires authenticated, secure access to sensitive resources at a scale and speed exceeding traditional security models designed for human users.
